sections.heading: AI Integration in the Military
paragraphs: According to teleSUR, China is accelerating the integration of artificial intelligence to modernize its armed forces. Additionally, La Tribuna de Cuenca reports that Xi Jinping has urged the Army to accelerate the military use of AI.

sections.heading: Military Modernization Goals
paragraphs: PressReader reports that Xi plans to have the most relentless army ready by 2027. This objective is part of the broader context regarding the modernization of military forces.
